title: Concept: HashiCorp Vault UI disclosed
description: The Vault UI is served at this endpoint, so the secrets-engine console, its seal state and its authentication methods are reachable.
applicability: Responses served by a Vault listener with the UI enabled.
risk: The UI exposes the seal state and the authentication methods, and an unsealed console is the entry point to every secret the engine holds; MEDIUM because the page alone does not prove a login is possible.
